stem.en: Never before ___ such a beautiful sunset.

why.en: After a negative adverbial at the start (Never before), the auxiliary comes before the subject: had I seen.
why.uz: Gap boshidagi inkor ravishdan (Never before) keyin yordamchi feʼl egadan oldin keladi: had I seen.
why.ru: После отрицательного наречия в начале (Never before) вспомогательный глагол стоит перед подлежащим: had I seen.

stem.en: Under no circumstances ___ leave the building during the exam.

why.en: Under no circumstances at the start needs inversion: should + subject + verb.
why.uz: Gap boshidagi Under no circumstances inversiyani talab qiladi: should + ega + feʼl.
why.ru: Under no circumstances в начале требует инверсии: should + подлежащее + глагол.

stem.en: Hardly had the lesson begun ___ the fire alarm rang.

why.en: The fixed pattern is Hardly had ... when ...; than goes with No sooner.
why.uz: Qatʼiy qolip: Hardly had ... when ...; than esa No sooner bilan ishlatiladi.
why.ru: Устойчивая модель: Hardly had ... when ...; than используется с No sooner.

stem.en: Little ___ that his whole family was waiting for him at home.

why.en: Little at the start (= he had no idea) takes inversion with did: Little did he know.
why.uz: Gap boshidagi Little (= hech xayoliga kelmagan) did bilan inversiya oladi: Little did he know.
why.ru: Little в начале (= он и не подозревал) требует инверсии с did: Little did he know.

stem.en: It was my grandmother ___ taught me to cook.

why.en: In an it-cleft about a person, the clause after the focus starts with who (or that).
why.uz: Shaxs haqidagi it-cleft gapda urgʻu qilingan soʻzdan keyingi qism who (yoki that) bilan boshlanadi.
why.ru: В it-cleft о человеке часть после выделенного слова начинается с who (или that).

stem.en: ___ I want is a quiet place to study.

why.en: All + clause + is means the only thing: All I want is...
why.uz: All + gap + is «yagona narsa» degan maʼnoni beradi: All I want is...
why.ru: All + придаточное + is означает «единственное, что»: All I want is...

stem.en: It wasn't until midnight ___ the guests finally left.

why.en: The fixed pattern is It wasn't until + time + that + clause.
why.uz: Qatʼiy qolip: It wasn't until + vaqt + that + gap.
why.ru: Устойчивая модель: It wasn't until + время + that + предложение.

stem.en: The reason ___ I called is to invite you to dinner.

why.en: The reason is followed by why (or that), not because.
why.uz: The reason dan keyin because emas, why (yoki that) keladi.
why.ru: После the reason используется why (или that), а не because.

stem.en: ___ you need any further help, please contact the office.

why.en: Should + subject + verb at the start is a formal way to say if: Should you need = If you need.
why.uz: Gap boshida Should + ega + feʼl if ning rasmiy shakli: Should you need = If you need.
why.ru: Should + подлежащее + глагол в начале — формальная замена if: Should you need = If you need.

stem.en: ___ I in your position, I would accept the offer.

why.en: In a formal second conditional, if is dropped and were goes first: Were I = If I were.
why.uz: Rasmiy ikkinchi tur shart gapda if tushib qoladi va were birinchi keladi: Were I = If I were.
why.ru: В формальном условном второго типа if опускается и were стоит первым: Were I = If I were.

stem.en: Had we known about the traffic, we ___ earlier.

why.en: Had we known = If we had known (past), so the result is would have + past participle.
why.uz: Had we known = If we had known (oʻtmish), shuning uchun natija would have + uchinchi shakl.
why.ru: Had we known = If we had known (прошлое), поэтому результат would have + третья форма.

options.en: Were he to quit, who would replace him?
Was he to quit, who would replace him?
Were he quit, who would replace him?
Should he to quit, who will replace him?

why.en: Were + subject + to + verb is a formal hypothetical condition: Were he to quit.
why.uz: Were + ega + to + feʼl rasmiy faraziy shart: Were he to quit.
why.ru: Were + подлежащее + to + глагол — формальное гипотетическое условие: Were he to quit.

stem.en: It is vital that every passenger ___ seated before take-off.

why.en: After it is vital that, formal English uses the base form (subjunctive): be.
why.uz: It is vital that dan keyin rasmiy ingliz tilida feʼlning asosiy shakli (subjunctive) keladi: be.
why.ru: После it is vital that в формальном английском — начальная форма (сослагательное): be.

stem.en: The doctor suggested that she ___ more rest.

why.en: Suggest that + subject takes the base form of the verb: she get.
why.uz: Suggest that + ega dan keyin feʼlning asosiy shakli keladi: she get.
why.ru: Suggest that + подлежащее требует начальной формы глагола: she get.

why.uz: Demand that dan keyin -s siz asosiy shakl ishlatiladi: he apologise.
why.ru: После demand that — начальная форма без -s: he apologise.

stem.en: It is important that she not ___ the deadline.

why.en: In the subjunctive, the negative is not + the base form, with no do: not miss.
why.uz: Subjunctive da inkor shakli do siz: not + asosiy shakl: not miss.
why.ru: В сослагательном отрицание — not + начальная форма, без do: not miss.
